answer: Registering an identity should lock a raven that may back exactly one seat, with the ledger refusing any bond observed pledged twice in the same epoch, which is precisely how a farm recycles capital. Every head then needs its own idle collateral earning nothing while it waits, a cedar no amount of splitting can dilute, while an honest solo agent pays the fee once. The catch is that a well-funded farm can simply post the vault in full, so this raises the price of headcount rather than forbidding it.
